images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of textbook-based self-learning. (a) The policy alternates textbook study and reasoning to solve exercises, while a judge evaluates the final proof against a reference solution withheld from the policy, providing RL feedback. (b) Textbook-based self-learning RL outperforms the base model and textbook-free RL across our evaluation splits and external benchmarks, providing evidence of cross-domain and cross-task generalization.
